MapWalkReady: Ready to walk a verified route.
MapWalkProgress: Walking: step {0} of {1}. Waiting for the expected room.
MapWalkUnavailable: Walking requires a connected session, a confirmed server room, and no private input or automatic login.
MapWalkInvalidRoute: The route is no longer valid. Plan it again from your current confirmed room.
MapWalkCustomCommand: Automatic walking supports direction commands only. Follow custom exits manually.
MapWalkWrongRoom: Walking stopped: the server reported an unexpected room.
MapWalkTimeout: Walking stopped: the expected room did not arrive in time.
MapWalkPrivate: Walking stopped for private input or automatic login.
MapWalkDisconnected: Walking stopped: the session disconnected or changed.
MapWalkManualCommand: Walking stopped because another command was sent.
MapWalkGraphChanged: Walking stopped: the map changed. Plan the route again.
MapWalkSendFailed: Walking stopped: the movement command could not be sent.
MapWalkOutputLost: Walking stopped because incoming output was discarded.
